topography.project_purpose: TG Casino is a decentralized gambling and staking platform on Ethereum, centered around its native TGC token. Users can stake tokens to earn rewards and participate in governance, while the protocol facilitates casino-style games of chance.
topography.relationship_narrative: The TGC token is the central asset used across staking contracts. StakingManagerV5 and MultiStakingManagerV2 both interact with TGCToken, and are accessed via upgradeable proxies that share the same deployer cluster.
